function generatorArrayProducer10() { echo "G|"; yield from [7, 11]; echo "N|"; yield 13; echo "F|"; return 23; }
function generatorArrayTarget10($first, $second, $third) { echo "D|", $first, "|", $second, "|", $third, "|"; }
function generatorArrayCaller10() { echo "P|"; $generator = generatorArrayProducer10(); generatorArrayTarget10(...$generator); echo "R|", $generator->getReturn(), "|"; }
generatorArrayCaller10();

purpose: A nested ordinary caller consumes two delegated array entries and a later direct yield; producer completion precedes the target and its return remains readable.

function generatorArrayReleaseTarget10($alpha = 17) { echo "BAD|"; }
$generator = generatorArrayRelease10();
try { generatorArrayReleaseTarget10(...$generator); } catch (Error $caught) { echo "T|"; }
echo "M|";
try { unset($generator); } catch (Exception $released) { echo "X|", $released->getCode(), "|"; }
echo "E";
purpose: A child destructor throws while last-owner Generator release drops its delegated table; forced finally and cached-child release precede the outer catch of that same exception.
